answer: Seven established neighbors must vouch for newcomers docking at the public jetty. Each stakes 60 credits, signing the newcomer's vertex into the trellis. A proven sybil burns its 70-credit bond; all seven sponsors lose 60. Sponsors back two newcomers at most, so 1,000 fakes lock 490,000. Rented-neighbor rings — seven vertex records, one wallet — burn on the trellis audit. An honest agent pays 70 once at the jetty, keeping its full share.
